headline: MIN @ DET matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIN 3.54 at DET 4.67, with a projected total of 8.21. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward DET: MIN moved -0.30 runs while DET moved +0.61, changing the projected margin by -0.91 runs. The projected total climbed +0.31, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: detailed outing logs were not available for every pitcher, so the page separates actual outings from analyzer L3/L5/L10 windows instead of treating those windows as box scores. Batter research is strongest for Kody Clemens, Riley Greene, Josh Bell, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jahmai Jones, Colt Keith because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
